# What the deploy scripts do not hold: app.client acme::docs::Docs.site

Facts the model declares that Cloudflare's configuration cannot carry, or that it leaves to
something else, each with how it is carried instead. Generated from the model: change the
model, not this file.

## production

From deployment.pages `acme::docs::siteProduction`.

| Fact | How it is carried |
|---|---|
| Build-time settings `SITE_URL` | Read by the build, which runs on the deploying machine: deploy/cloudflare/deploy.sh exports each one the model gives a value (a value already in the environment wins) and runs the build there. They never reach Cloudflare as settings. |
| Custom domains `docs.example.com` | Attached to the Pages project once, in the project's settings; an upload does not change them. deploy/cloudflare/doctor.sh checks each answers. |
